entries.text: Approval tab in the project tab navigation, next to the sidebar menu.
After an approver decides, the card moves to Done (approved) or In Progress (rejected) without reloading.
Approval status looks the same everywhere: Approval page, cards, table, detail sidebar and peek.
The Approval page loads much faster, which also fixes division managers not seeing the Approve button.
Boards no longer reload the approval queue for every card that appears.
